name: suede-emails
description: Suede-owned lifecycle email design for welcome, onboarding, nurture, re-engagement, post-purchase, and trigger-based sequences. Use when the user needs a multi-email flow with entry criteria, cadence, message roles, and a measurement plan: drip campaigns, welcome series, win-back flows, or trigger-based automations. NOT FOR: cold prospecting (use suede-cold-email), SMS as part of the same lifecycle program (use suede-sms), in-product activation flows (use suede-onboarding), or lifecycle-stage op
author: JasonColapietro
